rules: Label only what the website states. No outside knowledge. Copy quotes exactly. If pages disagree, record both as conflicting. If the site does not say, use not_found.
review_notes: pricing.public_plans is sourced from a NoBroker blog post (nobroker.in/blog/nobroker-seller-plans) rather than the live nobroker.in/seller/plans page itself, because that plans page appears to render its pricing table via JavaScript and the numbers did not appear in the fetched static content; the blog post is on the same domain and describes the same seller plans, but a human reviewer should verify current prices on the live plans page since these can change. No headquarters address was found on any fetched nobroker.in page (about-us, prophub about-us, or NRI about-us). customers.industries marked not_found because NoBroker is a consumer-facing marketplace and its site does not present a 'served industries' list in the B2B sense (its product lines -- packers & movers, home services, home loans -- were instead captured under products.names). The bank names on the home-loan page are loan-comparison/aggregation listings rather than a stated strategic-partnership relationship; flagged as a judgment call for traction.partnerships. No certifications, named case-study customers, or named competitors were found stated on the site itself. B-51 (2026-09-27): customers.segments' evidence was a paraphrase list ('Property owners and NRIs...; Tenants/renters...; Buyers and sellers...; Corporate employees...'), not literal quotes -- of that list, only the owners/NRI portion could be re-confirmed live via a genuine short on-site label ('Owners & NRI') plus the homepage tagline ('100% Owner Properties | Zero Brokerage'); the tenants/buyers/sellers/corporate-relocation portion was not independently reverified this pass and has been dropped rather than left unsupported. A human should re-check whether that broader claim is quotable elsewhere on-site before treating this narrower value as final.
